"Michael Burry is back at it again with his nonsense!

This time, he’s calling Lululemon (LULU) a 'fat pitch' while hype-pumping Chinese concept stocks like JD.com and Alibaba all over again. FinTwit is completely blowing up—half the comment section is blindly copying his trades, while the other half is screaming, 'Inverse indicator alert, run!'

To be fair, Burry has an incredible eye for 'deeply oversold value stocks,' but actually following his trades is plain suicide:

His timing is completely off: He took two agonizing years of drawdown during the subprime crisis that nearly blew him up, and in 2023 he screamed 'SELL' right before the market launched into a massive bull run. His underlying logic might be right, but your account won't survive the drawdown to see it pay off.

He loves catching falling knives: LULU is suffering from slowing consumer demand, and Chinese equities remain in a slump. He’s betting purely on 'mean reversion at peak pessimism.' For retail investors, blindly jumping into this kind of Deep Value play is a guaranteed way to get bag-held halfway down.

Option decay will eat you alive: He balances buying dirt-cheap stocks by purchasing Puts on NVDA and PLTR as a barbell hedge. Amateurs trying to mirror his Put positions usually get wiped out by Theta decay before the move even happens.

Treating his moves as a watchlist for oversold stocks is fine, but going all-in after him means you better be ready to bag-hold for months.

Honestly, best to just ignore the guy altogether!"

effective_posts.translation_zh:
“Michael Burry 又开始搞他那套胡言乱语了！

这一次，他称 Lululemon（LULU）是一个‘fat pitch’，同时又在到处炒作 JD.com 和 Alibaba 等中概股。FinTwit 已经彻底炸锅了——评论区一半人在盲目复制他的交易，另一半则在大喊：‘反向指标警报，快跑！’

公平地说，Burry 对‘严重超卖的价值股’有着惊人的眼光，但真正跟着他的交易操作简直就是自杀：

他的时机完全不对：在次贷危机期间，他经历了痛苦的两年回撤，差点把自己搞爆仓；而在 2023 年，他在市场启动一轮大牛市之前大喊‘SELL’。他的底层逻辑可能是对的，但你的账户未必能扛过回撤等到它兑现。

他热衷于接飞刀：LULU 正遭遇消费者需求放缓，而中国股票仍处于低迷状态。他押注的纯粹是‘极度悲观时的均值回归’。对散户来说，盲目冲进这种 Deep Value 玩法，基本就是一路下跌中途接盘被套的保证。

期权衰减会把你活活吞掉：他一边买入极其便宜的股票，一边买入 NVDA 和 PLTR 的 Put 作为杠铃式对冲。试图照抄他 Put 仓位的业余投资者，通常在行情真正发生之前就已经被 Theta 衰减清洗出局。

把他的操作当作超卖股票观察名单倒是可以，但跟着他全仓冲进去，就意味着你最好准备好套牢好几个月。

说真的，最好干脆完全别理这个人！”
